faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HP Jal Shakti Vibhag recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the HP Jal Shakti Vibhag recruitment is 13th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Para Cook and Para Helper posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies released by the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag. This includes 1 post for Para Cook and 2 posts for Para Helper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Para Helper post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Para Helper post is Matriculation (10th pass) from a recognized board or university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for both Para Cook and Para Helper posts is between 18 to 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the HP Jal Shakti Vibhag recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Para Cook post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Para Cook post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 9000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Para Helper post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Para Helper post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 5500/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Cook and Para Helper posts will involve a scrutiny of documents followed by a skill test.

faq.question: Q9. Does the qualification for Para Cook differ from Para Helper?
faq.answer: Yes, the qualification for Para Cook is higher. It requires Matriculation plus a degree/diploma in Hotel Management or 5 years of cooking experience, while Para Helper only requires Matriculation.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to the office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Kullu, as specified in the official notification.
